name: Meeting Brief Assistant
summary: Sends a Slack brief with attendee emails, agenda summaries, and talking points before each calendar meeting.

items.title: Calendar sync
items.description: Reads upcoming meetings from your calendar to trigger briefs.
items.proved_when: Upcoming calendar events are fetched successfully
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Last email thread per attendee
items.description: Finds the last email thread with each meeting attendee.
items.proved_when: The last email thread for each attendee is retrieved

items.title: Agenda PDF summariser
items.description: Reads attached agenda PDFs and generates a short summary.
items.source_quote: a summary of any attached agenda PDF

items.title: Talking points generator
items.description: Produces three tailored talking points based on emails and agenda.
items.proved_when: Three talking points are generated for the meeting

items.title: Slack brief message
items.description: Sends the compiled brief as a direct message on Slack.
items.proved_when: The brief message appears in Slack

items.title: Schedule brief timing
items.description: Triggers the brief delivery before the meeting starts.
items.proved_when: The brief is sent prior to the meeting start time

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should this post to?
How far in advance of each meeting should the brief be sent?
